events.notes: Portuguese environmental authority lists public consultation for Projeto Data Center Sines 4.0.
APA lists RECAPE for the execution project Data Center Sines 4.0; month precision retained because the index excerpt does not establish a more precise event date here.
Developer states additional grid capacity was secured, bringing campus plan to 1.2GW IT capacity. This is a developer claim, not an independent project-specific interconnection certificate.
REN independently reports 4,892.4 MVA allocated in the Sines High-Demand Zone. This validates regional grid allocation context but is not encoded as Start Campus-specific MW.
More than EUR20m transformer order from Siemens Energy for SIN02-06; source says long-lead equipment underpinned the then-2026 SIN02 timetable. No transformer MW is inferred.
DE-CIX interconnection and cloud services reported ready for service at SINES DC.
Official release states planned SIN02 is OCP Ready v2 and features the campus seawater cooling approach. This is design/certification evidence, not commissioning evidence.
Developer expected construction of SIN02 to begin later in 2025.
Developer later stated construction preparations were underway. This is not encoded as actual construction start.
Current developer site states the campus uses seawater cooling and eliminates freshwater use. This supports operating-context evidence but does not prove SIN02 commissioning.
